title: Map the RUM Group–Tether credit, collateral, and covenant structure
summary: Trace the five-year secured facility, pledged Northern Data assets, guarantees, conversion rights, defaults, and governance consequences across RUM Group and its subsidiaries.

provenance.method: free-range five-role primary-source review and bounded graph synthesis

workflow.next_action: Parse the complete credit agreement and security schedules.

data.target: RUM Group and Tether secured-credit structure
data.research_question: What assets, guarantees, covenants, default rights, conversion rights, and change-of-control provisions does Tether hold through the June 2026 secured facility?
hypotheses: Tether holds material creditor and collateral rights.
Creditor rights are not automatically equivalent to operating control.
objectives: Identify consent, default, conversion, and change-of-control rights.
Separate ordinary lender protections from governance rights.
